projects.name: GUI Murphy
projects.summary: AI-driven automated QA system for modern applications, focused on GUI behavior beyond pixel diffs.
details: Understands UI state transitions and validates multi-step user journeys via vision + language reasoning
Pipeline mentions OmniParser (YOLOv8), CLIP, and LLM reasoning
Real-time progress streaming (FastAPI + WebSockets) conceptually fits a live demo

caseStudy.problem: Traditional QA automation tools rely on pixel-perfect comparisons or brittle selectors that break with minor UI changes. Modern apps with dynamic content need semantic understanding of what the UI is doing, not just how it looks.
caseStudy.approach: Built a vision-language pipeline combining OmniParser (YOLOv8) for UI element detection, CLIP for semantic matching, and LLM reasoning to understand user journeys. The system validates behavioral correctness rather than visual similarity.
challenges: Achieving real-time inference speed while maintaining accuracy across diverse UI frameworks
Handling dynamic content and async state changes in SPAs
Building a robust test specification language that non-technical QA could use
caseStudy.codeHighlight:
# Vision-Language Pipeline
async def validate_journey(screens: List[Screenshot]):
    elements = await omniparser.detect(screens)
    semantics = clip.encode(elements)
    return llm.reason(semantics, expected_behavior)

projects.name: 2D AI Roguelike Engine
projects.summary: 2D AI-powered game engine for infinite generation with enforced consistency across narrative and visuals.
details: Visual identity caching for consistent NPC appearance

caseStudy.problem: AI-generated games often feel incoherent—characters change appearance mid-game, storylines contradict themselves, and the world lacks internal consistency. Players notice these breaks in immersion immediately.
caseStudy.approach: Developed a context management system with event logging for narrative memory and visual identity caching. Each entity maintains a consistency hash that's validated against all generated content before rendering.
challenges: Balancing infinite variety with consistency constraints
Optimizing context window usage for longer play sessions

projects.name: LinkGuard
projects.summary: URL safety analyzer that detects phishing attempts and malicious links in real-time.
details: Multi-layer URL analysis including domain reputation and content scanning
Browser extension integration for seamless protection
Machine learning model trained on phishing datasets

caseStudy.problem: Phishing attacks are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with attackers using legitimate-looking domains and SSL certificates. Users need real-time protection that goes beyond blocklist matching.
caseStudy.approach: Built a multi-layer analysis pipeline: domain age/reputation checking, SSL certificate analysis, visual similarity detection against known brands, and ML-based content classification. Packaged as a lightweight browser extension.
challenges: Achieving low false-positive rates without missing novel attacks
Keeping the extension lightweight for minimal browser impact
Training ML models on imbalanced phishing datasets

projects.name: Agentformer
projects.context: AIT x Redis x Cloudflare Mini-Hack
projects.summary: AI agent orchestration system enabling multi-agent collaboration for complex task completion.
details: Multi-agent coordination with Redis pub/sub for real-time communication
Cloudflare Workers for edge-deployed agent execution
GCP integration for scalable compute and storage

caseStudy.problem: Single-agent AI systems hit capability ceilings on complex tasks. Multi-agent systems exist but suffer from coordination overhead, message passing bottlenecks, and difficulty in maintaining shared state.
caseStudy.approach: Built a distributed agent orchestration layer using Redis pub/sub for real-time coordination, Cloudflare Workers for edge execution, and a central state manager on GCP. Agents can spawn, communicate, and delegate seamlessly.
challenges: Minimizing coordination latency across distributed agents
Handling agent failures gracefully with task reassignment
Preventing infinite loops in agent-to-agent delegation
